patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Campaign Monitor only if your buying job matches “Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and En” rather than Drip's shape. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than Campaign Monitor's shape. Workflow advantage: Campaign Monitor leans shared coverage; Drip leans ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Campaign Monitor is Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and Enterprise.; Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo..
- Workflow coverage skew: Campaign Monitor-leaning — vs Drip-leaning ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: Campaign Monitor — No forever free plan — trial only; Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo.

Limitations — Campaign Monitor: No forever free plan — trial only; Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders; Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows.

Poor-fit cases: Campaign Monitor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever free plan — trial only · Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Avoid Campaign Monitor if you actually need Drip's motion (Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
